story.title: Today's goal: lines 5 and 6 short, calm and clear
story.content: Today: lines 5 and 6 sound calm and steady. They are short, so the goal is a slow, warm pace with clean tones. Line 5 is built in two chunks: 此后 / 他失去自由 / 五十多年. Line 6 in three: 我的祖母赵一荻 / 一直陪在他身边. No progress file yet: tap "Send progress to my coach" in the app's Progress screen and paste it in the chat so I can tailor tomorrow.

pronunciationTip:
PRONUNCIATION CLINIC. (1) sh / zh vs s / z (失 shī, 赵 zhào, 十 shí, 身 shēn vs 自 zì, 祖 zǔ): for sh and zh curl the tongue tip back; for s and z keep it flat behind the teeth. Contrast: 失去 shīqù vs 自由 zìyóu; 祖母 zǔmǔ vs 赵 Zhào. (2) 一 changes tone: in 一直 the dictionary tone is yīzhí, but before the 2nd tone 直 it is spoken yì (yìzhí). In the name 赵一荻 it stays yī (Zhào Yīdí), because it is inside a name. (3) q and the 3rd tones: 失去 shīqù, with q like a soft "ch" and the lips spread. 此后 Cǐhòu: 此 dips low then flows on. 我的祖母 wǒ de zǔmǔ: two 3rd tones together, so 祖 sounds like a rising 2nd tone before 母; say it smoothly, "wǒ de zǔmǔ". Neutral tone: 的 de light and short. DELIVERY: slow and gentle. Stress 失去自由 and 五十多年, then slow down on 陪在他身边 as the warm part. Pause after 此后 (short) and after 赵一荻 (short breath). Pace: about 4 seconds each at final speed.
**Daily run-through:** read all 13 lines of the main speech aloud once (about 90 sec), then listen to full_speech_normal.mp3 once. Practice plan (10–15 min): listen to today's shadowing.mp3 (3 min); shadow each chunk twice, then each whole line twice; record lines 5 and 6 in the app's Speak coach and compare; listen to full_speech_normal.mp3 once.

quiz.question: Review from Day 5: in line 4, how do you say 一致 (dictionary yīzhì)?
quiz.correct: yízhì. 一 changes to yí before the 4th tone 致
